reasons.plausibility: It is fully consistent with established knowledge of Cr2O3 passivation and the role of grain boundaries in enhancing diffusional healing in stainless steels.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment—comparing corrosion metrics (EIS, weight loss, surface chemistry) on fine-grained vs. coarse-grained variants under well-defined conditions—provides a clear, feasible way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Although it extends established concepts of chromium-based passivation, it provides a concrete, systematic test plan and identifies microstructural criteria for improved corrosion resistance, making it valuable for alloy design.
